main.description: A geographic location using ISO standard codes - can represent a researcher's home country, organization location, or event venue

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, AT, DE, JP)

region.description: ISO 3166-2 region/state/province code (e.g., US-CA for California, GB-ENG for England) - optional

isVirtual.description: Whether this is a virtual/online location (for virtual events)
